events.title: Wade's 2004 summer plan
events.prompt: Miami's staff confirm the medical review, the designated program dates and the defensive and ballhandling work; private specialists answer Wade's approaches.

details.Player focus: Ballhandling under pressure, defensive discipline, physical durability, more situations for an existing jumper; a between-possession reset after mistakes
details.Staff plan and availability: Miami medical and strength staff and Spoelstra's staff to confirm; Miami's designated program (at most two weeks) attended for the $236,180 incentive
details.Baseline and protocol: Simulated 2003-04: 75 G, 39.7% 3P on 2.4 attempts, 90.9% FT; baselines (body composition, movement, shooting spots, turnovers under pressure, screen film) to be taken by staff
details.Planned / completed sessions: None completed yet; private approaches (Tim Grover, Dave Hopla, Jim Loehr's practice, a sports dietitian) not yet agreed; Haslem invited privately

next_checkpoint.trigger: Miami schedules its designated offseason program and the staff confirm the baselines

events.title: Wade's 2004 camp teamwork focus
events.prompt: Wade's camp priority is team integration, with extra shared work alongside Udonis Haslem, Dorell Wright, and Caron Butler.

details.Player focus: Work within the team structure and improve group chemistry rather than chase an individual camp role.
details.Priority teammates: Udonis Haslem, Dorell Wright, Caron Butler
details.Shared work: Team concepts, timing, communication, and learning how the group fits together.
details.Role authority: This is Wade's player focus; the coaching staff still owns depth-chart and rotation decisions.

next_checkpoint.trigger: Training camp opens and the focus moves from planned to actual camp work

events.title: Wade's 2005 summer plan
events.prompt: Miami's staff confirm the medical assessment, the designated program dates and the baselines for Wade's defense, shot-selection and passing work.

details.Player focus: Man-to-man defense 35%, shot selection 30%, passing 25%, skill maintenance 10%; less time on new isolation moves, mechanics rebuilds, long-range volume, nonessential dribble combinations and weight gain
details.Staff plan and availability: Spoelstra's staff with Miami's medical, video and strength staff as the primary structure; Miami's designated program (at most two weeks) attended for the $252,660 included incentive; preseason conditioning test for another $252,660
details.Baseline and protocol: Simulated 2004-05: 76 G, 36.2 MPG, 21.3 PTS, 4.0 AST, 1.3 TOV, 65.7% TS; coaches to set defensive, shot-selection and passing baselines from practice possessions and film; skills review about every two weeks
details.Planned / completed sessions: None completed yet; private specialists not contacted for 2005; Haslem invited privately (does not depend on his signing); professional guards and wings to be invited for live work

next_checkpoint.trigger: Miami schedules its designated offseason program and the staff confirm the baselines

events.title: Wade's contract extension outlook
events.prompt: Miami's front office decides on 2006-10-31 whether to offer; Wade answers the actual offer then.

details.Wade's terms: Five additional seasons from 2007-08; first year 20% below his fair market value on the decision day; first four seasons guaranteed; 2011-12 a Miami team option; raises up to 10.5% of the first-year salary; no no-trade clause
details.Rules: Rookie-scale extension window to 2006-10-31; up to five seasons beyond 2006-07; one option season, the last (cbafaq05 Q51, Q52)
details.Scouting recommendations: Kyle Lowry (Villanova, PG) and P.J. Tucker (Texas, F) for the 2006 draft, weighed only on Miami's own picks
details.If no offer: Wade plays out his rookie contract; restricted free agency in July 2007 if Miami tenders a qualifying offer
